title.value: NL-PS-L4-A - Level 4a: Two minimal GBBs per section - TargetedValidation

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 4a test patient, in which every mandatory section except Medication summary has at least two entries that refer to generic building blocks (GBBs) in the document, and has a narrative, and Medication summary has no entries, and has an emptyReason and a narrative. Conformancelab sends the bearer token you enter at test setup to your server. Use a token issued by your own system that gives access to your level 4a test patient, and only to that patient. Without a token the server may return the Patient Summaries of several patients; the script then tests the first one. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/

name.value: Retrieve and check Patient Summary document

description.value: Retrieve the NL-PS as a document Bundle with $document and check the document as a whole. The sections are checked in separate tests.
Retrieve the NL-PS as a document Bundle with $document and validate the Patient that the Composition refers to against nl-core-Patient.

Retrieve the NL-PS as a document Bundle with $document and check section Problems (LOINC 11450-4). The section must have at least two entries. If not, the remaining checks of this test are skipped. The Condition of the first two entries is validated against nl-core-Condition; further entries are not validated.

Retrieve the NL-PS as a document Bundle with $document and check section Allergies and intolerances (LOINC 48765-2). The section must have at least two entries. If not, the remaining checks of this test are skipped. The AllergyIntolerance of the first two entries is validated against nl-core-AllergyIntolerance; further entries are not validated.

Retrieve the NL-PS as a document Bundle with $document and check section History of procedures (LOINC 47519-4). The section must have at least two entries. If not, the remaining checks of this test are skipped. The Procedure of the first two entries is validated against nl-core-Procedure; further entries are not validated.

Retrieve the NL-PS as a document Bundle with $document and check section Medical devices (LOINC 46264-8). The section must have at least two entries. If not, the remaining checks of this test are skipped. The DeviceUseStatement of the first two entries is validated against nl-core-DeviceUse; further entries are not validated.
Retrieve the NL-PS as a document Bundle with $document and check that section Medication summary (LOINC 10160-0) has no entries, and has an emptyReason and a narrative.
